additions.reason: The Torah explicitly states that a woman of this dangerous spiritual type IS a bechina of Arich Anpin of the Kelipah. Arich Anpin (Long Face / the Vast Countenance) normally refers to the highest partzuf of holiness — but the Kelipah has its own mirror version. This evil Arich Anpin is characterized by 'long faces' (פָּנִים אֲרֻכִּים), meaning it reaches and pursues in every direction — whichever way the person turns, the impure thought follows. This is the same domain as Package 1: it is the spiritual force behind the lecherous thoughts, the evil countenance that generates them. It belongs in the evil impurity package as the spiritual root/identity of the danger described.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ בְּחִינַת אֲרִיךְ אַנְפִּין בַּקְּלִפָּה... כִּי הִיא בְּחִינַת אֲרִיךְ אַנְפִּין שֶׁל הַקְּלִפָּה, שֶׁהֵם פָּנִים אֲרֻכִּים, וְעַל־כֵּן בְּכָל צַד שֶׁיִּפְנֶה תִּזְדַּמֵּן לוֹ

analysis_notes.good_evil_mirror: This Torah has only one package (evil). The implicit good counterpart — צדקה (charity/righteousness) — appears only in eitza edges as the remedy/cause-effect relationship (charity saves from death). It is not bechina-connected to any other node, so it does not form a good package in this Torah's dataset. The Torah's structural teaching is: evil domain (lecherous thoughts = death) → overcome by good action (charity = rescue from death), but the good side is expressed through eitza flow rather than a bechina cluster.
